ato.name: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato.description: Analyzes mesh UV-to-texture mappings, shrinks UV islands to the target quality, strips unused UV area and repacks islands into atlases to maximize texture utilization.
ato.generateAtlas.tooltip: When disabled, no atlas is generated, unused UV is not stripped and UV is not re-arranged. Textures are only scaled and other optimizations are applied.
ato.padding.tooltip: Minimum distance between islands inside an atlas. Values: 4, 8, 16, 32, 64.
ato.density.tooltip: Clamps island scaling by the real world size of the model. Presets: 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192.
ato.npot.tooltip: When enabled, atlas edges step by 64px instead of powers of two. NPOT is validated to work with MipStreaming and Crunch; incompatible compression formats (e.g. PVRTC on iOS) are excluded.
ato.mipstreaming.tooltip: Single switch controlling both Mipmap and MipStreaming. VRChat requires MipStreaming to be enabled whenever Mipmaps are enabled.
ato.whitelist.tooltip: Objects listed here (meshes, materials, textures, animations) have all of their textures skipped from every optimization, including parameter optimization.
ato.whitelist.empty: Drag objects here to exclude them from optimization.
ato.platform.override.tooltip: Enable a platform to override optimization parameters for it. Defaults read the current build target.
ato.verbosity.tooltip: Controls how much debug detail is printed to the console. Keep enabled while the tool is in development.
ato.progress.cancelled: ATO cancelled by user. Temporary assets on disk are kept, CPU/GPU/memory resources released.
ato.report.title: ATO Report
ato.report.nothing: Nothing to optimize (all textures whitelisted or ineligible).
ato.error.multipleComponents: Multiple {0} components found on this avatar. Only one is allowed per avatar subtree.
ato.error.noDescriptor: The GameObject holding {0} must also have a VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ato.error.noTextureReadable: Texture '{0}' is not readable. Enable Read/Write on its import settings or add it to the whitelist.
ato.warn.whitelistSkip: [Whitelist] '{0}' is whitelisted; all its textures are skipped.
ato.warn.unsupportedShader: [Unsupported shader] Material '{0}' uses shader '{1}' which ATO cannot analyze safely; its textures are treated as whitelisted.
ato.warn.stTransform: [ST transform] Texture '{0}' on material '{1}' uses a non-identity ST / scroll-rotate; treated as whitelisted.
ato.warn.decal: [Decal / special usage] Texture '{0}' is used as a decal or with parallax on material '{1}'; treated as whitelisted.
ato.warn.uvOutOfBounds: [UV out of bounds] Mesh '{0}' has UV out of [0,1] that cannot be normalized without crossing a wrap seam; treated as whitelisted.
ato.warn.cannotFitAtlas: [Atlas] Texture '{0}' (UV group) cannot fit into the largest atlas; atlas generation skipped for this group, scaled in place instead.
ato.warn.grayscaleMultiChannel: [Compression] Grayscale texture '{0}' has multiple channels but a single-channel format was requested; saved as multi-channel.
ato.warn.alphaFormatMissing: [Compression] Transparent texture '{0}' cannot use a format without alpha; a safe alpha-capable format is used.
ato.warn.npotFormatExcluded: [NPOT] Compression format '{0}' is incompatible with NPOT atlases and was excluded.
ato.warn.animationTransform: [Animation] Texture '{0}' is affected by an animated ST / scroll-rotate; treated as whitelisted.
ato.warn.meshScaleAnimated: [Animation] Mesh '{0}' scale is animated; using maximum scale for area calculation.
ato.warn.noAAO: AAO (Avatar Optimizer) is not installed; UV evacuation compatibility is skipped.
ato.warn.fallback: [Fallback] '{0}' fell back to a safe path: {1}
ato.compression.graySingleChannel: Force single-channel grayscale (multi-channel content is still saved multi-channel)
